caseName: Wasatch Cnty. v. Ute Indian Tribe of the Uintah
caseNameFull: WASATCH COUNTY, UTAH v. UTE INDIAN TRIBE OF THE UINTAH AND OURAY RESERVATION.

opinions.text: Motion of Myton City for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
